name: libxsmm-strassen-three-buffers-neon-packing
hypothesis: Replace only the measured three-buffer Strassen wrapper's packing loops with four-lane NEON FP32 loads, copies, additions, subtractions and stores. Each 256-element row uses 64 groups with no alignment assumption. Product calls, recombination, allocation, fallback and all BSD notices remain unchanged. This source change is absent from the supplied measured history. Compilation, correctness and performance are untested; the compiler may already vectorize the original loops. Require all fixed correctness checks, including cancellation, scale separation, guards and allocation failure, before ten validations and ten alternating paired controls under unchanged power settings. Promotion still requires min(candidate)>1.05*max(control), followed by held-out checking. The fresh same-mode baseline peak is 1102.214208818538 GFLOP/s; the prior Strassen wrapper's paired-control peak is 1091.5737628886607. Keep historical Battery Automatic peak 1668.5964359101147, AC initial-baseline peak 1685.6230608449698 and AC unchanged-control peak 1687.3925479742732 separate. No new measurements, speedup, causal attribution or goal completion are established.
